verdict.rationale: Jev documents a maintained Python SDK changelog (jev-docs-27) and a clear model-versioning scheme with pinned IDs (jev-latst/jev-preview → jev-1.13.0) plus guidance to pin versions and migrate on your own schedule (jev-supp-versioning), and a dated 'last reviewed' jaggedness/limitations page (jev-supp-jaggedness). This gives developers a way to track API/SDK and model changes, though the evidence shows only a single changelog entry and no dedicated model release-notes feed distinct from the versioning page. Missing for 10: a fuller/browsable changelog history, an explicit model release-notes page (vs. just version IDs), and independent confirmation that the changelog is actively/regularly updated.
